repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not ((#SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30|))
triggered = false
}
wait until((#SoundSensor).soundSensor_sound > 30|)
all(#AirPurifier).airPurifier_setAirPurifierMode("sleep")
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly requires the Bedroom sensor to be <= 30 before firing (line 3) and uses an OR condition for the wait (line 6), whereas the IR requires a rising edge on the SoundSensor group (any) without excluding the other sensor. The IR's `any` binding implies an existential quantifier, requiring the `>` operator with the `|` suffix to match at least one device, not a conjunction with a negation.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the conjunctive guard with a rising-edge rearm pattern using `not` for the false state. Changed the wait condition from an OR of raw comparisons to an exists-quantified comparison (`> 30|`) matching the `any` binding slot. This ensures the action fires on the first rising edge across either sensor and rearms correctly when both drop below the threshold.
